info.name: forgescheduler-async-job-orchestration-queue-engine Postman Collection
info.description:
The central brain of the ForgeSphere ecosystem. 
Manages asynchronous job scheduling, priority queuing, retry policies for failed builds, 
and real-time worker pool metrics. 
It decouples the API layer from the execution layer, ensuring high throughput 
and fault tolerance for all Enhancement and Assessment pipelines.


OpenAPI version: 1.0.0

Responses:
- 202: Job successfully scheduled and accepted into the queue.
- 400: Invalid request payload or unsupported job type.
- 503: Scheduler queue is full. Please try again later.
- 500: Unexpected error while interacting with the thread pool or blocking queue.
